messages:
maria: quick heads-up — we're cutting RC in ~2h. need a quick sync: SDK docs regen + site deploy must happen before the public rollout. who can own the regen?

devon: I can take the regen. do we have the version bump PR merged into rc yet?

maria: PR is open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4321 — version bump to 1.12.0-rc. waiting on kevin for final review.

kevin: looking now, small nit in package.json. I can merge in ~15m. ping me if you need me to fast-track.

olivia: FYI QA needs the docs URL to smoke test new console screenshots after deploy. can we preserve the previous path so links don't break? :thinking_face:

maria: yes, keep /console/ path stable. doc-bot: please include redirect instructions if filenames change.

doc-bot: noted — add redirects to /docs/console/v1/ if any filenames are renamed. I can auto-generate a redirects manifest once the regen output lands.

devon: after merge I'll run `npm run docs:build && npm run docs:regen-sdk` locally, push the regenerated markdown to the docs branch, then open a PR for the site deploy. quick checklist: version bump merged -> regen -> docs PR -> deploy job. anyone want step ownership differently?

kevin: merged. CI green. :tada:

maria: awesome. devon, can you also bump the changelog entry to include the console fixes + new batching hints? simple bullet points are fine.

devon: will do. also will include a short note about the breaking kwarg rename in the SDK: `batch_size_hint` -> `preferred_batch_size` so clients have a heads-up.

sylvie: can someone add a short blurb in the Console release notes about the new tracing toggle? product asked for that.

maria: sylvie, can you write that blurb? 2-3 lines is fine; we'll paste into the changelog and the console docs.

sylvie: on it, dropping text in this thread in a few mins.

devon: regenerated docs pushed to branch `docs/regen/1.12.0-rc` and opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2187 — includes SDK API surface changes + redirects manifest.

deploy-bot: docs PR CI passed; scheduled site deploy for 2026-03-18 10:00 UTC if no objections.

maria: sounds good. olivia, QA can you validate the console screenshots after deploy and report any visual regressions by EOD?

olivia: will do, assigned to QA run and smoke tests.

kevin: quick heads-up — please keep the RC cutoff at 09:30 UTC to allow rollback window before deploy job triggers. that gives infra 30m.

maria: noted. devon, can you ensure the docs PR is merged before 09:30 UTC?

devon: yes, target merge by 09:15 UTC. I'll ping in #eng-oncall if anything blocks.

maria: perfect. final ask: update the release checklist entry `docs_deploy` to reference the PR and the redirect manifest file path so on-call can verify quickly. I'll update the checklist doc now. :white_check_mark:
